intro: Melor Sends Word is a summons delivered by Jorn Skyseer in the Barrens on behalf of the renowned hunter Melor Stonehoof. Rising adventurers who have proven their grit across Kalimdor are directed to Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff to receive a far more demanding trial.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.
If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor. You will find him on Hunter's Rise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, friend, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?
If so, young adventurer, then listen on...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
